UserVault.title: UserVault
UserVault.description: Private automatic cloud backup vault for a Morfo publisher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the publisher.

vaultCode.description: Publisher's 6-16 character Cloud Sync & Partner Code.

visits.description: Bounded array of publisher return visits and Bible courses (max 500).

timeEntries.description: Bounded array of publisher hour logs (max 1000).

monthlyStats.description: Bounded array of monthly study count overrides (max 120).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync.

PartnerShare.title: PartnerShare
PartnerShare.description: Cloud Vault & Partner Share document keyed by the publisher's Cloud Code.

ownerId.description: Device or Auth UID of the publisher.

sharedVisits.description: Bounded array of schedule & GPS items (max 500).

vaultVisits.description: Bounded array of full visit records for cloud backup (max 500).

vaultTimeEntries.description: Bounded array of time entries for cloud backup (max 1000).

vaultMonthlyStats.description: Bounded array of monthly stats for cloud backup (max 120).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when document was created.

/userVaults/{userId}.description: Private cloud backup vault per Google Auth UID.

/partnerShares/{shareCode}.description: Cloud sync & partner schedule document keyed by shareCode (works on any domain including GitHub Pages and Android PWAs).
